title: Locker Rental: damage fee, lost key fee and key replacement turnaround by tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Locker Rental product line. It states, for each of the six Locker Rental tiers, the fee charged for damage to the locker, the fee charged for a lost key or fob, and the number of days needed to process a replacement key or fob. The rule governing how the damage and lost-key fees are billed on the rental is a separate handling matter and is not restated here.

## Damage, lost key and replacement table
| Tier | Damage fee | Lost key fee | Key replacement processing time |
|---|---|---|---|
| Small Locker | $20.00 | $10.00 | 2 days |
| Medium Locker | $25.00 | $10.00 | 2 days |
| Large Locker | $30.00 | $10.00 | 3 days |
| Premium Climate-Controlled Locker | $40.00 | $15.00 | 3 days |
| Day-Use Locker | $15.00 | $5.00 | 1 day |
| VIP Locker Suite | $50.00 | $20.00 | 1 day |

## Equivalent restatement (by question)
- What is the damage fee for a Premium Climate-Controlled Locker? Forty dollars.
- Which tier carries the lowest lost-key fee? The Day-Use Locker, at five dollars.
- How many days does it take to process a replacement key for a VIP Locker Suite locker? One day.

## Points of judgement
The damage fee and the lost-key fee both rise with the tier's rank for every tier except the Day-Use Locker, whose fees are fixed lower than any monthly tier's; the key replacement processing time, by contrast, is fixed shortest for the Day-Use Locker and the VIP Locker Suite alike, so a shorter turnaround does not track a lower fee.
